description: HTTP retry utility. Functions: get_with_retry(url,params=None,headers=None,retries=3,backoff=2.0,timeout=10)->Response|None. post_with_retry(url,json=None,headers=None,retries=3,backoff=2.0,timeout=10)->Response|None. Both retry on ConnectionError,Timeout,5xx responses. Exponential backoff: wait=backoff**attempt. Returns None if all retries exhausted (logs warning). Also: safe_json(response)->dict|None catches json.JSONDecodeError. Designed to replace raw requests.get/post in all sentinel modules. No daemon.
